payload.rationale: The perspective map for this repository is sparse, containing only a Strategy area with two decision children (DiagnosticFirst, KnowledgeMapping), both about business consulting methodology. The document is a short technical note about an E2E test reproducing a missing-id failure pattern in markdown heading processing, slug generation, and crash prevention. No area in the map substantively covers software testing, ID derivation, markdown processing, or error handling. I expanded all available areas (Strategy and both children) to give the extraction passes the full context the graph offers, but the overlap is thin: DiagnosticFirst's 'understand before solving' frame is the closest conceptual neighbor to 'reproduce the failure before fixing it,' and KnowledgeMapping's gap-report deliverable is a distant echo of diagnostic test coverage. No area was deliberately excluded — the entire map was surfaced.
